create_solver_adam: create an Adam solver for approximating Nash equilibria in symmetric games with configurable temperature and learning rate
test_solver_descent_step: test the solver descent_step method that performs projected gradient descent on exploitability using Euclidean projection
review_solver_compute_gradients: review the solver compute_gradients method that computes exploitability gradients with optional Shannon entropy regularization
summarize_solver_exploitability: summarize the solver exploitability method that returns exploitability as average squared norm of projected gradient
build_gradients_function: build exploitability gradients using stochastic estimation with two samples and optional temperature-based entropy regularization
